title: DriveAlign structured driving output contract v7
description: Single-image driving scene analysis output contract. Changes from v6 (S13 contract v7 ruling): (1) risk_factors closed over the revised 6-item taxonomy in configs/contracts/v7/risk_taxonomy.json — corridor_conflict removed (constructively nested; its static remnant is absorbed by the widened stationary_obstacle in-path condition) and congestion removed (starved label) with its slot re-purposed as object_near; vehicle_merging renamed vehicle_crossing and pedestrian_crossing widened to vru_crossing (pedestrian + bicycle + motorcycle), both gated by a unified lateral-velocity rule; (2) critical_objects items additionally carry bev_x / bev_y — the ego-frame [x_forward, y_left] position in meters (0.1 m granularity) of the nearest point of the object's footprint, complementing bbox_2d (2D grounding) and the center-distance semantics of the GT-only distance field. Each risk_factors item is an object {factor, objects}: objects lists the ids of the critical_objects that trigger that factor (risk attribution, ruling V7-A1). bbox_2d is [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in absolute input-image pixel coordinates, origin top-left. Open-vocabulary model results are normalized by the versioned synonym tables; unmapped terms are recorded, never silently repaired.

critical_objects.description: Objects relevant to the current driving decision. Empty list allowed. Hard cap of 8 items keeps token length and scoring deterministic.

risk_factors.description: Risk attribution list: each item pairs one canonical factor from configs/contracts/v7/risk_taxonomy.json (synonyms normalized by the parser before validation) with the ids of the critical_objects that trigger it; objects is non-empty and references ids assigned in this response. Empty list allowed; duplicate factors not allowed (parser-enforced).

objects.description: Ids (0-7) of the critical_objects triggering this factor; at least one; ids must exist in critical_objects (parser semantic check).

yield_required.description: True when the ego vehicle should yield to another road user or situation.

speed_action.description: Requested speed control action. Ground truth for evaluation is derived from future physics by the M09 oracle.

id.description: Unique integer (0-7) identifying the object within this response; risk_factors entries reference objects by this id. Duplicates are a parser semantic failure.

category.description: Canonical category from the nuScenes detection class set; synonyms normalized via configs/contracts/v7/category_vocab.json.

bbox_2d.description: Four integers [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in absolute image pixel coordinates, origin top-left (token-budget ruling 2026-10-11: the prompt teaches integers; the parser accepts numbers and rounds nothing here). Corner-order and image-bounds checks are applied by the parser as semantic validation.

motion_state.description: Coarse motion state; ground truth derivable from nuScenes box velocity relative to ego. Canonical values defined in configs/contracts/v7/motion_vocab.json.

bev_x.description: Forward position of the nearest point of the object's footprint relative to ego, in meters in the ego frame (x = ego heading direction), rounded to 0.1 m. Complements bbox_2d (2D grounding); the GT-only distance field keeps center-distance semantics.

bev_y.description: Leftward position of the nearest point of the object's footprint relative to ego, in meters in the ego frame (y = left; negative = right), rounded to 0.1 m.
